units: <cite ref="Shabbat 22b:2">Sabb. 22ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Menachot 86b:10">Men. 86ᵇ</cite> <he>נר מערבי שנותנין וכ׳</he> the westernmost light (on the candlestick in the Temple) into which as much oil was put as all the others together contained.
<cite ref="Shabbat 22a:5">Sabb. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>מנר לנר מדליקין</he> you may light one Ḥanuckah light on the other; a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 28b:8">Ber. 28ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>נר ישראל</he> light of Israel (great scholar).—

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 36:3">Ex. R. s. 36</cite> <he>נֵרִי</he> my (the Lord’s) light (the Law), <he>נֵרְךָ</he> thy (man’s) light (the soul); <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 31:11">Lev. R. s. 31</cite> <he>נֵרִי</he> (the Lord’s light in the Temple).—Pl. <he>נֵרוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 6:1">Tam. VI, 1</cite> <he>שני נ׳ מזרחיים</he> (Talm. ed. <he>שתי נ׳ מערביים</he>, corr. acc.) the two easternmost lights. Ib. III, 9 (30ᵇ) <he>שתי נ׳ מזרחיות</he> (Talm. ed. <he>ב׳ נ׳ מערבית</he>, read <he>מערביות</he> or <he>מערביים</he>); a. fr.
